auditScope: PM Skill Release and Native DSH Loader Integration
summary: Locked DSH packages (@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill 0.1.1-rc.2, @deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem 0.1.1-rc.2, @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill 0.1.1-rc.2) provide mature catalog scanning and <skill_content> rendering, but LACK native versioning, contentHash parameters, and run-pinning. Modifying SKILL.md on disk causes content hash drift during an active Run. A minimal host integration solution using immutable release directories (releases/{skillId}/{version}/) combined with release-snapshot.cjs pinning and a host Manifest completely closes this gap without re-inventing a skill engine.

packagesAudited.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill
packagesAudited.role: Cordis tool plugin exposing skill tool and slash invocation

packagesAudited.name: shell/skills/release-snapshot.cjs
packagesAudited.role: Host release content identity builder and Run pin generator

versionPinning.finding: Native DSH loader only addresses skills by string name. It has no version or contentHash parameter in its public API.

contentHashDrift.nativeBehavior: Disk file edits immediately take effect on subsequent ctx.skills.get() calls
contentHashDrift.finding: Native loader does not snapshot skill instruction bodies per-Run. Modifying SKILL.md during a session alters the instructions seen by the model.

disableAndRevocation.nativeBehavior: All valid SKILL.md files in customSkillDirs are discovered
disableAndRevocation.finding: Native DSH provides no disableSkill(id) or revokeSkill(id) persistent API; exclusion relies on directory mutation or host manifest gating.

permissionBoundary.finding: Tool authorization is owned by ctx.tools (ToolRuntime). Metadata or text inside SKILL.md cannot self-authorize OS or bash tools.

proposedHostIntegrationSeam.loaderMount: FileSystemSkillProvider configured with customSkillDirs pointing to exact pinned version directories per-Run
proposedHostIntegrationSeam.heatSessionRevocation: cancelActiveRunsForMemoryChange / revision invalidation signal when Manifest status changes
